title: Don't waste your money
text: Don't waste your money. Not a lot of ways to say that I was surprised by this and disappointed, but "on fire" I think sums it up. Burning plastic, lots of smoke and the appliance help on the computer told me to unplug it, and I think you know I had already done that. I did not find it helpful to be told to wash off the elements inside of the toaster oven when it was still smoking. Considering the metal top sunk into the side of the toaster and you couldn't open or roll back the door at that point.
